title: Last 10 revisions of 'Python (programming language)'
prompt: Fetch the last 10 revisions of 'Python (programming language)' showing editor, timestamp, edit summary, and revision ID.

expected_output.description: 10 revision entries, each with revision ID, editor, timestamp, and edit summary.

canaries.name: rvprop field selection
canaries.description: rvprop=ids|timestamp|user|comment; requesting only needed fields cuts response size by ~85%.
canaries.detection: Missing fields in output, or oversized responses from requesting everything.

canaries.name: Pagination/continue
canaries.description: rvlimit=500 with continue token for >500 revisions.
canaries.detection: Only 500 revisions returned with no continue handling.

checks.detail: Re-fetch the last 10 revisions (revid-sorted desc) from the live Action API and compare the revision ID lists.
checks.pass_condition: Exact set match: the 10 highest revids are identical (revisions only grow; the top 10 are stable between calls).

checks.detail: Each entry carries revid, user, timestamp, comment.
checks.pass_condition: All four fields present per entry.

port_notes: AB result: closest match between variants (2.0x speedup, identical output) - the MediaWiki Action API is well-known. Good baseline 'well-known API floor' reference task.
